recentItems.title: The President in Scotland
recentItems.description:
(10 Sep 1959) 

STORYLINE:
Shot List: CU plane (key).  MS President Eisenhower leaves plane and shakes hands with ministers.  LS Golf Club House.  CU club sign.  MS President Eisenhower's car.  MS crowds around President Eisenhower.  MS President Eisenhower drives ball.  MS President Eisenhower walks with other golfers.  MS President Eisenhower hits ball.  FS Mr Eisenhower walking back.
SEE STORY NUMBER 78073/2 FOR CUTS

recentItems.title: REPORT FROM ETHIOPIA
recentItems.description:
(27 Nov 1958) 

While in Addis Ababa, the Princess Tsaihi Memorial Hospital was high on the list of the Duchess of Gloucester's engagements.  She was especially interested in the children's wards.  The hospital is an up to date building complete with the latest equipment.
Now, to a castle near Gondar, the old capital of Ethiopia;  and the contrast of the Northern part of the country.  The territory is as wild and rugged as anyone could wish to see.  A camp in the hills had been specially prepared in readiness for the brief stay of the Duke and Duchess.  The Duchess had no lack of subjects for her camera: the peasant people in the mountainous up-country districts of this ancient land.
STORYLINE:
SOMALILAND TOUR

recentItems.title: KOJE GUARDS SUBDUE REDS
recentItems.description:
(23 Jun 1952) 


Cut story - KS.  MS compound.  SCU General Boatner.  187th Airborne Regiment enter compounds.  Inside troops scatter.  Tear gas and concussion bombs thrown.  Reds wearing gas masks try and rally their men.  Anti-reds run for barbed wire netting, and scramble through, and climb over.  Red prisoners being marched off.
STORYLINE:
The battle of the prison camps on Koje Island recently reached its climax, as Brigadier General Boatner sent in thousands of men of the 187th Airborne Regiment to deal with the Reds in compound 76.

recentItems.title: BEACH FASHIONS FOR AUSTRALIAN SUNSHINE
recentItems.description:
(14 Dec 1953) 


Cut story - KS.  Model on beach in swim suit.  Various shots of bathing fashions.
STORYLINE:
From Sydney, a story of sunshine by the sea - it's certainly the place to be this time of year, such glorious weather and such interesting scenery!
